title: docs(objectui): concept.mdx collapsed-by-default section example authors collapsible too
body:
Fixes #19703
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`content/docs/protocol/objectui/concept.mdx`, section "1. Progressive Disclosure": the YAML example captioned "Advanced section (collapsed by default)" authored `collapsed: true` with no `collapsible`. It now writes both keys (`collapsible: true` + `collapsed: true`), and one sentence under the block states the rule the spec states: `collapsed: true` implies `collapsible` — a section that starts closed always carries the disclosure control that reopens it. +4 / -0, one file, docs only.

## Why

The spec half is already on `main`: `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` (FormSectionSchema, "The collapse pair, declared once for both members") declares that `collapsed` IMPLIES `collapsible` as a renderer rule (maintainer ruling 2026-09-18, letter A), and that parse never rewrites the pair. So a section authored `collapsed: true` alone parses to `collapsible: false, collapsed: true`, and any renderer that reads the parsed `collapsible` without applying the implication draws a section that starts closed with no toggle. Writing both keys is correct under the spec's wording (`collapsible: true` beside `collapsed: true` is the fully explicit spelling) and renders a working toggle on every surface.

Measured against the built spec at `a3091327`: `FormSectionSchema.safeParse` of the corrected section returns success with `{collapsible: true, collapsed: true}`; the old section returns `{collapsible: false, collapsed: true}` — the premise holds.

## Renderer surfaces (objectui at the `.objectui-sha` pin `main` carries today, `87af769e9a3e`)

The pin has not moved since the card was filed, so the card's citation still applies. Read at that pin:

- `packages/plugin-form/src/DrawerForm.tsx:609` and `:677` pass `collapsible: section.collapsible` alone (and `:653` gates collapse on `section.collapsible`). The old example rendered closed with no toggle here; with both keys it renders a toggle and starts closed. **Safe with the corrected example.**
- `packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx:1539-1560` applies the implication (`collapsed` implies `collapsible`). Safe with either spelling; **safe with the corrected example.**

Writing both keys does not depend on the pin: it is safe whether or not a later pin makes DrawerForm apply the implication.

## Changeset

Docs-only: `content/docs/**` is not in any package's `files[]`, so nothing publishes — `skip-changeset` territory. Labels are left to the PM seat (no label write from this PR's author).

## Verification

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` (change set taken from git, merge base `1cacfe4a`): 40 commands, all run at `a3091327`, all exit 0. Reconciled with `--ran`: "40 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 40 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 40 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)". Four gates first exited 3 (prerequisite not met: `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/formula`, `@objectstack/client-react` unbuilt); after building those closures they re-ran green.

Note: `check:yaml-examples` validates only tagged blocks and reports `concept.mdx: 0 tagged / 9 untagged`, so its green does not cover this block; the direct `FormSectionSchema.safeParse` reading above is the measurement for it.

## Acceptance notes

- Sibling pages, silences rather than copy-and-fail, **not edited here**: `content/docs/ui/views.mdx:416-417` (section key table lists `collapsible` / `collapsed` with no word on the dependency) and `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx` (the same pair at several lines; its authored example already writes both keys). Carrier: none named.
- The DrawerForm residual (reads `section.collapsible` alone) is objectui's, not this repo's.
